headline: WillScot Holdings (WSC) Stock Dropped, What Is Driving Attention Now?
summary: WillScot Holdings (WSC) has added former Republic Services chief executive Donald Slager to its board as an independent director, drawing attention to how fresh governance experience might influence the modular space solutions group. Recent trading has been rough for WillScot Holdings, with the share price down 6.97% over the past week and 12.12% over the last month, extending a 41.67% decline in the 90 day share price return and a 23.89% drop in the 1 year total shareholder return.
